name: Kuzo
detailed_description:
Paradise has fallen. You were born to restore it. The Shape encourages you.

Explore the secrets of a lush planet with ancient ruins as the celestial spirit Kuzo. With a growing array of world-altering powers, uncover the haunting story of the Drowned Planet in your quest to restore a bridge to the metaphysical world, and ultimately save the planet from catastrophe.

After awakening from his thousand-year gestation, Kuzo discovers the Shape, an ancient technology that carries world-altering magic: Spawn rising lily pads on the surface of any body of water. Transform spiky hazards into usable platforms. Control moving lifts and gates that mimic the Shape’s movement. Create crawling horizontal vines to quickly traverse low ceilings. There are many secrets within the Shape. Kuzo combines the thrill of a tight 2D platformer with the freedom to make creative decisions while navigating the world.

Features

  • Run, jump, dash and soar through an interconnected world on platforms of your own creation. Expand your abilities and use them creatively to progress. There are endless ways to get where you’re going.

  • Explore over a dozen hand-crafted environments in an interconnected Metroidvania world, from the center of a fallen civilization to dark, uncharted caves deep underground, and beyond.

  • Solve labyrinthine, puzzle-box dungeons, each with unique mechanics and effects on its surroundings, and each housing a critical ability.

  • Discover secrets hidden in plain sight as you gain knowledge of the world and its systems.

  • Help otherworldly NPCs, diverse beings trapped in remote corners of the abandoned planet.

  • Immerse yourself in an original soundtrack that evolves with your journey.

  • Collect and equip items to customize your journey to your preferred play style.

  • Unravel a story of epic proportions that unfolds through environmental storytelling. What exactly happened to this once-thriving land?

The Shape invites you to discover the secret history of the Drowned Planet. Will you fulfill your purpose and connect with the ancient civilization that created you, or will Paradise remain forever submerged? The fate of this world rests in your hands.
